name: mymind
tagline: Save your notes, links, and images, then find them without manually organizing folders.
description:
mymind is a private visual library for notes, bookmarks, articles, images, and references that emphasizes saving first and organizing later. It identifies and visualizes the things you save so that retrieval can begin with an association—such as a color, brand, keyword, or date—rather than a carefully maintained folder system.

Save a link, image, highlight, or note when it appears, then use search and the visual library when you need it again. This suits research, inspiration, product references, reading, and personal knowledge that would otherwise be split between browser tabs, photo albums, and notes apps.

## Features

- Save notes, bookmarks, articles, images, and inspiration in one visual library through supported apps and browser extensions.
- Search by text, color, brand, date, and other associative cues instead of relying solely on folders and manual tags.
- Recognize saved links such as articles, products, books, and recipes and present them with contextual visual treatment.
- Read saved articles in a simplified, distraction-reduced view and capture highlights.
- Use Smart Spaces, bidirectional links, AI summaries, and resurfacing tools such as Serendipity where the current plan supports them.
- Sync the library across current macOS, iOS, Android, and browser-extension workflows.

## Where it fits

mymind fits an individual who gathers a great deal of visual research and wants to retrieve it without building a taxonomy. It complements a writing or project system by serving as a personal reference shelf.

It is not a team workspace or a replacement for deliberate filing when a project needs clear shared ownership. Its automatic organization also means you should test whether its search model feels reliable for the material you save.

## Privacy and requirements

mymind is an account-based service that synchronizes saved material across devices. Links, notes, images, highlights, and generated organization therefore participate in its cloud privacy model rather than remaining a simple local archive. Browser extensions can see the pages a user chooses to save; review the current privacy policy and avoid storing secrets that belong in a password manager.

## Pricing

mymind is subscription-based: from $7.99/month or $79/year.
